data.name: Keep Chaos
data.detailed_description:
Fight. Adapt. Survive.

Keep Chaos is a medieval low-poly 3D third-person bullet hell roguelite where every run brings a new challenge. Battle relentless hordes of enemies, discover powerful synergies, and forge unique builds as chaos consumes the battlefield.

Choose from 8 unique heroes, each with their own weapons, abilities, and distinct playstyles. Master devastating melee combat, wield powerful magic, or dominate enemies with ranged attacks—every hero offers a completely different experience.

Create Powerful Builds

Every level presents meaningful upgrade choices. Combine weapons, charms, relics, passive abilities, and powerful items to create game-changing builds. Experiment with countless combinations and adapt your strategy, because no two runs are ever the same.

Fight through dangerous medieval environments, survive increasingly deadly enemy waves, and defeat powerful bosses standing in your way. Every victory earns valuable rewards, while every defeat prepares you for your next adventure.

With satisfying progression, intense third-person combat, and endless replayability, Keep Chaos blends addictive roguelite progression with fast-paced bullet hell action in a stylized low-poly fantasy world.

Grow stronger. Master the chaos. Become the kingdom's last hope.

Play Solo or Together

Fight alone or jump into the chaos with up to 4 players in online co-op. Team up with your friends, complete objectives, defeat powerful bosses, and create unique builds every run. Cooperation is the key to survival, but every battle brings a new challenge.

Team Up for Battle

Gather your allies and charge into battle together.

Fight shoulder-to-shoulder against fearsome enemies and massive bosses with support for up to 4-player online co-op.

A True Challenge Awaits

Keep Chaos shows no mercy. Its difficulty is designed to test your reflexes, decision-making, and teamwork rather than offering an easy path to victory. Every new wave is more dangerous than the last, and every boss requires a different strategy.

If you enjoy demanding gameplay and the satisfaction of overcoming difficult challenges, Keep Chaos is for you.

Only the strongest survive.

Shape Your Own Playstyle

Build your character exactly the way you want.

Every time you level up, choose from three different upgrades to create powerful combinations. Use the Shrines of Luck scattered throughout the map to increase your chances of finding rare and powerful abilities. If fortune favors you, legendary rewards and rare upgrades can also be found inside treasure chests.

Every Run Is Different

No two adventures are ever the same.

Random rewards, diverse character builds, unexpected events, and constantly evolving strategies ensure that every run offers a fresh experience worth mastering.

data.short_description: Survive endless hordes in 3D — solo or with up to 4 friends. Keep Chaos is a co-op bullet-heaven roguelite: pick a hero, stack chaotic builds, and last as long as you can.
data.supported_languages: English, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Turkish, Ukrainian, Italian, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Thai

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-Byte
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 or Amd Equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 750 or Amd Equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-Byte
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
